title: Every API call, inspected live
caption: A DevTools tab lists each fetch and XHR call with status, timing, headers and a pretty-printed body.

title: Mock any response in seconds
caption: Pick a request, press Mock this, and return your own status, body, headers and delay.

title: Test empty and error states
caption: Build UI for failures before the backend exists, and flip each mock on or off from the toolbar.

title: Built for GraphQL too
caption: Requests show their operation name, and rules can target a single query such as GetDeals.
